convert_string_to_bgr_tuple: convert a color string like 'red' to a BGR tuple using color_val function
convert_int_to_bgr_tuple: convert a single integer grayscale value to a BGR tuple using color_val
convert_tuple_to_bgr_tuple: validate and return a 3-element BGR tuple using color_val function
